reason: Machine lens: dm_index is zero page &0067 (listing: A4 67 LDY dm_index), so LDY zp is 2 bytes 3 cycles, a real 6502 opcode; PHY (5A, 1 byte 3 cycles) + PLY (7A, 1 byte 4 cycles) = 2 bytes 7 cycles. Saves 4 cycles an execution, 0 bytes: record_live's layout (A02F-A072) and everything after it are unchanged, so no page crossing or branch range moves. No self-modified operand or data read in these lines (no record_live+n references). Y = dm_index at both JMP record_live (9313->9317 sky path: LDA #0/STA abs,Y/LDX dm_slot leave Y; 9356->9367: LDX back/ADC/STA/LDX dm_slot leave Y); the only store to dm_index is put_on's at 9307; world_of_address/late_column write only wa_off(&49/4A), wa_x_lo/hi(&60/&5F), wa_y(&57), with a balanced PHA/PLA, no TSX/TXS. LDY sets N/Z from the same value PLY would.
